title: Cyrus and the Parish
author: Astrid Marchetti
blurb: Paloma Okafor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
